key_insight: REPA connects agents’ local responses to system-level error propagation, revealing how intermediate errors can compromise final answers.
engineering_relevance: Modeling error propagation can help engineers target recovery interventions instead of relying only on final-answer evaluation.
method: Separately estimate input assembly and agent processing across multiple error channels.
Connect local response measurements to system-level error predictions.
Use propagation estimates to guide targeted retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
evidence_signal: Across three Qwen base models, six workflows, and ten ErrPropBench-10 settings, REPA achieved mean condition-level Spearman correlation of 0.84 versus 0.47 for direct regression; REPA-guided RAG improved accuracy by 19 percentage points over no retrieval with 16% additional tokens.
watch_item: Generalization beyond the tested Qwen models and workflows remains unestablished in the abstract.
paper_title: From Local Errors to System Failures: Modeling and Benchmarking Error Propagation in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
